## What you should be able to do tonight

- Produce one number for the required Sharpe threshold that you are willing to be held to for eleven months.
- State the mapping from this phase onto genome-wide multiple testing in one paragraph, without forcing the parts that do not fit.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>50 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Finish reports/milestone-02-noise-floor.md: the six-panel stylized facts figure with your numbers, the Sharpe-as-estimator section with the standard error and the autocorrelation correction, the three corrections table, the trial-count audit, and the noise floor with its calculation.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Write the paragraph that nobody else in your interview pool can write: the correspondence to genome-wide association studies, with the row that does not carry over named explicitly. A forced analogy is worth less than an honest one with a boundary on it.
:::
:::

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, ninth sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, and the square root of 2, 3 and 5 to three decimal places from memory.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Symmetry and conditioning combined: a fair coin is flipped 100 times. Given that the first 50 flips contained 30 heads, what is the expected total number of heads? Then, given that the total was 60 heads, what is the expected number in the first 50? Say why the two questions are not the same shape.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Two months of drills have accumulated. Write down the three problem types that have been slowest for you so far. That list is the thing you actually track, not any individual answer.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Milestone 2 sets the evidence bar for everything that follows. qlib/stats.py, qlib/simulate.py and qlib/noise.py are now the three modules that every later strategy result passes through before it is allowed to be called a result.
:::
